title: Structural Directives
description: Learn how structural directives shape or reshape the DOM structure using TemplateRef and ViewContainerRef in Angular.

blocks.text: Structural directives are directives that change the DOM layout by adding and removing DOM elements. While modern Angular applications primarily use control flow syntax (@if, @for, @switch), custom structural directives are essential when you want to manipulate template rendering dynamically.
A structural directive injects TemplateRef to access the template contents and ViewContainerRef to control rendering into the view hierarchy:

code: import { Directive, Input, TemplateRef, ViewContainerRef, inject } from '@angular/core';
